topic: Render Texture Eraser Field Hole Fix
userLatestRead: User playtested live and reported severe visual bugs where parts of the playing field disappeared, with a screenshot showing missing rectangular chunks of the grass board.
currentGoal: Fix and ship the live field visual bug without disturbing unrelated dirty docs/media files.
diagnosis: Common-layer tile stamps are centered via RenderTexture.stamp(... origin 0.5).
Dirty tile cleanup used RenderTexture.erase(frame, x, y), and Phaser treats the coordinates for frame erase as exact/top-left-style drawing, not the same centered stamp semantics.
Fast click/live fallback work increased how often dirty tiles erase common-layer footprints, making the old coordinate mismatch visible as field chunks being removed.

changesMade.summary: eraseCommonTileFootprint now uses RenderTexture.stamp(COMMON_TILE_ERASER_TEXTURE_KEY, ..., { erase: true, originX: 0.5, originY: 0.5, scale: boardScale }) so erased footprints align with centered, scaled tile stamps.

verificationRun.result: passed visually after 72 real canvas clicks across the dense field; no field chunks disappeared, and batch mode settled with small dirty/stale counts.

nextRecommendedSteps: Smoke test the live site by fast-clicking a large field and watching for missing tile chunks.
If visual field holes still appear, inspect any remaining direct RenderTexture.erase usage and collect a fresh screenshot plus perf overlay line.
doNotRevert: Do not switch eraseCommonTileFootprint back to RenderTexture.erase(frame, position.x, position.y); that coordinate mismatch can erase neighboring common-layer tiles.
Keep the erase stamp centered and scaled with boardScale so it matches drawCommonTile's centered tile stamps.

Do not stage, clean, or revert unrelated AGENTS.md, docs/DESKTOP_MAC_SYNC_WORKFLOW.md, Dutch automation docs, GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, title-art artifacts, MIDI/AIF files, or old test handoff unless explicitly instructed.
